pr_target: dev (no PR — commit direct per AIPLA workflow)

features.description: db/group_sessions.py — Firestore mapping from group_id to most-recent session_id, with 30d TTL matching ADR-001 group-code TTL.
acceptance_criteria: get_active_session_for_group(group_id) returns the most-recent non-archived session_id, or None
set_active_session_for_group(group_id, session_id) writes atomically (Firestore transaction)
archive_active_session_for_group(group_id) sets archivedAt and clears the active pointer
TTL: stored records older than 30d are filtered at read time (or via Firestore TTL field if available)
Simultaneous-join race: two concurrent writes both end up pointing at the same session_id

features.description: Extend /api/auth/group/join to look up existing session for the group and return it in the JoinResult.
acceptance_criteria: JoinResult shape gains resumedSessionId field (null when no existing session)
First join for a group: resumedSessionId=null, JWT minted as today
Re-join within 30d: resumedSessionId set to the saved id; same JWT shape
Re-join after class revocation (1.A M5 path): still raises GroupRevoked (resume not bypassed by class gates)

features.description: POST /api/sessions/{id}/restore — returns chat history (last 50 messages + summary of older turns) + workbench snapshot.
acceptance_criteria: Returns {messages: [...last50], olderTurnsSummary: string|null, workbenchState: {...}}
Caps at 50 messages even for heavy-use codes (server-enforced)
Summary of older turns either pre-computed (from prior session-end summary) or computed on-demand via a one-shot LLM call
401 if caller's JWT isn't bound to that session_id's group
404 if the session is archived (reset path)

features.description: Frontend resume detection on /chat/[...path] mount + ResumeWelcomeBanner. Banner dismissible (Danish + English copy).
acceptance_criteria: On chat mount: if join response contained resumedSessionId, fetch /api/sessions/{id}/restore
Restored messages render in the chat history before the user types anything
ResumeWelcomeBanner shows 'Welcome back — continuing from your last session' / Danish equivalent; dismissible
Fresh session (no resume): banner does not render; existing behavior unchanged

features.description: useStableThreadId adapter consumes the resumed session_id when present; otherwise mints fresh.
acceptance_criteria: Hook takes optional initialSessionId param
When initialSessionId set: returns it verbatim, no new id minted
When unset: mints a fresh id (existing behavior)
URL is updated to /chat/<skill>/<resumedSessionId> on resume so refresh works

features.description: Artefact contract: aipla:restore JSON-RPC notification + Boldkast implementation. Sliders restored to saved values; revealed markers restored.
acceptance_criteria: BoldkastSimFrame sends ui/notifications/aipla:restore with {v0, theta, g, revealedMarkers} after artefact initializes (if a workbench state was restored from M3)
Boldkast artefact handles the inbound notification: applies values, updates sliders, re-reveals markers
Restored state does NOT count as pendingChanges (no flush trigger)
Artefact-side handler is no-op for unknown payload shape (defensive)
features.notes: StaticArtefactFrame.sendNotification ref method already exists (from 1.E-Ph2 M4); reuse.

features.description: Teacher [Reset session] button. Archives session + clears workbench state. Next join with the same code starts fresh.
acceptance_criteria: Button visible on /teacher/classes/[id] near each group code
Click → confirmation dialog → POST /api/sessions/{id}/archive (or similar)
After archive: next /api/auth/group/join for that code returns resumedSessionId=null
Teacher-only: 403 for anonymous-group users hitting the archive endpoint

features.description: Update mcp-app-artefact skill convention with the aipla:restore pattern so LED Planck + KineBot inherit.
acceptance_criteria: SKILL.md gains a 'Restore on resume' section describing the ui/notifications/aipla:restore notification + handler pattern
Code snippet shows the artefact-side handler + the host-side ref.sendRestore() call
Cross-references session-persistence.md and 1.E-Ph2 convention

features.description: Smoke + quality gates + direct-to-dev merge. New scripts/smoke-v1-session-persistence.sh exercises the full chain.
acceptance_criteria: scripts/smoke-v1-session-persistence.sh exits 0 against LOCAL_MODE
cd backend && make lint + make test-fast green
cd frontend && npm run quality:check green
No emoji introduced
Branch rebased onto origin/dev and FF-merged
origin/dev pushed

queue_rationale: Independent of 1.G-Ph3 (can swap order; either can go first). Big UX win for the pilot — students can rejoin from any device for 30 days. M6 builds on the 1.E-Ph2 sendNotification ref pattern. Could parallelise with 1.G-Ph3 since they touch mostly disjoint files.
